subject.title: Telegram: keep long DM turns alive through progress previews

question: Should Telegram long-turn liveness reuse the existing progress-preview surface for direct messages, with detached finals allowed only when an already-confirmed visible preview can be finalized after newer DM activity?
rationale: The PR intentionally asks for UX contract confirmation and changes message freshness semantics; automation can review bugs but cannot choose the durable Telegram user experience.

options.title: Confirm DM progress-preview contract
options.body: Proceed with this UX direction after fixing the integration blockers and adding live Telegram proof.

options.title: Move design to shared auto-reply runner
options.body: Reject the Telegram-owned private hook and require a shared runner-level long-turn contract before this branch continues.

options.title: Defer to broader progress work
options.body: Pause this PR and route the remaining behavior into the existing Telegram progress/native-quote roadmap item.

recommendation.title: Confirm DM progress-preview contract
recommendation.body: Proceed with this UX direction after fixing the integration blockers and adding live Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is one of the explicitly requested design reviewers and has adjacent merged progress-draft work in the same feature area.
